name: obsidian-sync-mcp
description: Real-time bidirectional sync between Obsidian vault and Claude Code

notes.obsidian_to_claude: When user edits and saves a note in Obsidian, MCP syncs it to Claude context within 1 second
notes.claude_to_obsidian: When a skill creates or modifies a note, MCP pushes it to Obsidian automatically
notes.restriction: Only syncs on explicit user edit or skill action — no spontaneous changes

setup_instructions: 1. Install obsidian-vault MCP in Claude Code settings
2. Point vault_path to your vault directory
